s.g: A traditional Chinese unit of length, 10 Chinese feet or ¹/₁₅₀ Chinese mile.
A poisonous bird from Chinese mythology that is said to have existed in what is now southern China.
(Singapore, colloquial, transitive) To modify (a gadget or vehicle).
(Singapore, colloquial, transitive, by extension) To embellish or redecorate.
(Chinese contexts) Synonym of congee, a thick rice porridge.

(historical) An ancient Chinese unit of weight, notionally equivalent to 100 millet seeds or 1/24 of the liang/tael/Chinese ounce, chiefly used in denominating small coins in ancient and early imperial China.
(music, historical) An ancient Chinese string instrument thought to have had a rectangular zither-like body with silk strings played with a bow.
A member of an ethnic group living mostly in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in southern China.
